subject: Mobile Development
title: The Kernel: The Phone's Brain
description: A quick, practical guide to The Kernel: The Phone's Brain.

hook.text: Beneath every app and every screen, a kernel manages the entire phone.

buildup.text: The kernel allocates memory, schedules processes, and talks to hardware drivers.

discovery.text: Both iOS and Android use kernels derived from Unix — a 1970s operating system family.

twist.text: Android uses the Linux kernel. iOS uses XNU, a hybrid of Mach and BSD Unix.

climax.text: The kernel runs silently, but every tap, swipe, and notification flows through it.
